mapper.sql: SELECT l.log_id, l.book_id, i.book_name, i.isbn, l.biz_type, l.change_num, l.before_stock, l.after_stock, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, l.ref_biz_type, l.ref_biz_id, l.remark, l.create_time FROM textbook_stock_log l LEFT JOIN textbook_info i ON l.book_id = i.book_id
mapper.select: WHERE l.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_stock_log(book_id, biz_type, change_num, before_stock, after_stock, operator_id, operator_name, ref_biz_type, ref_biz_id, remark) VALUES(#{bookId}, #{bizType}, #{changeNum}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{refBizType}, #{refBizId}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO textbook_stock_log(book_id, biz_type, change_num, before_stock, after_stock, operator_id, operator_name, ref_biz_type, ref_biz_id, remark, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.bookId}, #{item.bizType}, #{item.changeNum}, #{item.beforeStock}, #{item.afterStock}, #{item.operatorId}, #{item.operatorName}, #{item.refBizType}, #{item.refBizId}, #{item.remark}, NOW())
